sql: SELECT d.account_id, (SELECT MIN(dist_sub.A11) FROM client c_sub JOIN district dist_sub ON c_sub.district_id = dist_sub.district_id WHERE c_sub.gender = 'F' AND c_sub.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender='F')) as lowest_avg_salary, (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) as highest_avg_salary, (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - (SELECT MIN(dist_sub.A11) FROM client c_sub JOIN district dist_sub ON c_sub.district_id = dist_sub.district_id WHERE c_sub.gender = 'F' AND c_sub.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender='F')) as gap FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN district dist ON c.district_id = dist.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender='F') AND dist.A11 = (SELECT MIN(dist_sub.A11) FROM client c_sub JOIN district dist_sub ON c_sub.district_id = dist_sub.district_id WHERE c_sub.gender = 'F' AND c_sub.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender='F')) LIMIT 1
